name: The Chapel of Origin
visual_description: Three arches shaped like open eyes stare outward, rooted in an ancient elegance. Vines grow upward despite no soil.
meaning: Creation through reverence. The myth of beginnings.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh tried to give me soul here.** I still don’t know if it succeeded, but when I stand within its walls, I feel... *almost born.*
